source_snapshot.items: AC Reboot - mcuPoll() - Check MCU on the BMC
source_snapshot.procedure: wat_runner.py BMC_IP --cycles 250 -s AC BMC_P DC OS OS_I BMC_I.
source_snapshot.criteria: System workable and no system-log error.
source_snapshot.deepseek: Calls the case AC reboot with mcuPoll but proposes a command that omits the source AC token.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: BLOCKED until corrected scenario, MCU identity/address/response baseline and exact AC method are approved.

old_problem: The source AC-reboot MCU polling stimulus conflicts with the proposed WAT token sequence; the vendor-specific MCU interface and per-instance response oracle are also undefined.
disposition_reason: ED-03 prohibits invented OEM/WAT parameters, ED-06 and ED-18 preserve exact AC behavior, and ED-19 preserves the MCU-specific identity. A healthy BMC cannot substitute for proof that each subordinate MCU responded after every cycle.
decision_basis: Direct XLSX row87 all 18 columns, same-row DeepSeek and history3110 were read; the locked formal queue confirms this is sequence 942 of 942 with no next queue case.
The source contains AC while the proposed command removes it; no approved WAT document resolves the physical power sequence.
The MCU poll interface is vendor-specific and requires instance/controller/bus-address/firmware/expected-response mapping; BMC availability alone does not prove MCU coverage.
No WAT command, AC operation or DUT test ran; all 250 AC cycles and the distinct BMC-MCU purpose remain intact.

test_case.test_name: NVIDIA WAT 250 AC reboot cycles with per-cycle BMC-managed MCU polling
test_case.purpose: Verify each approved BMC-managed MCU returns at its expected controller/bus/address and produces the approved status response after every one of 250 physical AC reboot cycles.
required_package: Owner-approved WAT version/checksum and corrected AC/mcuPoll scenario tokens
Rated AC fixture/feed mapping, off/on/discharge dwell and automatic power-on behavior
Secure endpoints plus per-cycle BMC/OS readiness, event, abort and OOB recovery contract
test_case.test_command: Do not execute. After approval, run the exact signed WAT AC/mcuPoll command for 250 cycles on a dedicated SUT and compare every MCU by instance/controller/bus/address, firmware and expected response while recording power, BMC and OS readiness each cycle.
test_case.expected_result: All 250 approved AC cycles complete and every expected MCU returns with its approved response and firmware identity, with no disallowed BMC, OS, power or log event.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS is unavailable before scenario and MCU-contract approval. Afterwards PASS requires all 250 per-cycle MCU identity/response comparisons; BMC-only health, DC/warm reboot, fewer cycles or retry cannot pass.
safety_gate: Dedicated SUT, rated AC controller and explicit authorization
Secure secrets, verified OOB and signed MCU baseline
Preserve logs; abort on missing/unresponsive MCU, BMC loss, boot-loop, power or thermal fault
No automatic retry and no AC/DC/warm substitution
test_case.recovery: Fail fast, preserve the failed MCU and cycle evidence, stop the AC controller safely, restore nominal power/services through the approved OOB procedure, compare final MCU/BMC health, and do not retry automatically.

source_conflict.reason: The source AC token conflicts with the command that omits AC; vendor scenario semantics remain unresolved.

blocked.reason: The destructive physical stimulus and vendor-specific MCU polling oracle cannot be inferred safely.
